name: JavaScript web server with management dashboard

mentions.name: JavaScript web server with management dashboard
mentions.description: A web server written in JavaScript with an accompanying server management dashboard. It is designed to be much faster and less complicated than Apache or NGINX and serves HTTP and WebSockets from the same port.
mentions.problem: Apache and NGINX are complicated and slower.
mentions.source_excerpt: A new web server written and server management dashboard in JavaScript that is much faster and less complicated than either Apache or NGINX and serves HTTP and WebSockets from the same port.

evidence.value: A new web server written and server management dashboard in JavaScript that is much faster and less complicated than either Apache or NGINX and serves HTTP and WebSockets from the same port.
